name: Glossary Term Audit
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
tip: Use Open source or Open target below a finding to open that note at the affected paragraph.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Glossary Term Audit is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it to check your translations.
